mainText:
Hello, Verona! Here is your daily dish.

It is a sizzling eighty-eight degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School, feeling like a sticky ninety-two under those clear skies. Try not to melt out there!

On the green scene, apartment dwellers can drop off food scraps at the Badger Prairie site, and you can also snag handy city rebates for installing rain barrels.

In police news, K9 Drea had a very busy week, alerting officers to drugs during two separate traffic stops.

Finally, Culver's is closed right now, but they open at 10:00 AM tomorrow with Snickers Swirl.

Stay cool, Verona!
